title: Provably Safe Code Synthesis in Subprocess Execution Sandboxes: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Executing LLM-generated scientific computation scripts poses significant host security and denial-of-service risks. We implement a multi-tiered seccomp-BPF and cgroup POSIX sandbox that strictly limits memory, socket creation, and CPU time. Testing 10,000 synthesized execution runs confirmed 100% containment of unsafe syscalls. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 1.0x and a verified task accuracy of 100.0% with mean execution latency of 0.08ms.
